description: Staleness and eligibility per tier and workflow, read by pump/due.mjs. mode: always = due when there is no result for the current run_key (first sight, new SHA or digest, new tool, oracle or probe version), on a change event, or when the last result is older than max_age_days (null = no age limit); sample = due only when a sampling hook picks it; never = not run for this tier. capture_range_max_age_days is passed through to live-probe and is not used by the due list yet. A run_key sent back as retry_later (every skip retryable) is not due again until retry_backoff_minutes x 2^(n-1) after its n-th retry. unversioned_max_age_days: for a subject with no sha and no artifact digest (its run_key cannot move with new versions), the max age used where a cell's max_age_days is null. A run_key sent back as retry_throttled (every skip a retryable rate limit or upstream outage) waits the same backoff, never more than retry_backoff_max_minutes. skips_only_max_age_days: an accepted result that held no records and only retryable skips whose retries ran out is due again after this many days (reason skips_only), doubling for each such result in a row, never later than the tier's max age. priority.coverage_gap_share: a due pair that has no result yet, or was never assessed and last hit a passing condition, or whose last result is unassessed by our own limit (a tool or unknown fault) and is due because something moved (tool_version, new_version, change_event), gets this share of its tier weight added to its priority, capped one point under the weight gap to the next tier up (R-COV-03, R-COV-05, R-COV-06); it orders due pairs and never makes a pair due. Oracle disagreement (loop upgrade #7): a subject whose oracles disagree (state oracle_disagreements, status open) gets, on the lanes in priority.oracle_lanes, an oracle_recheck due reason (weight priority.oracle_recheck) once its last result is older than priority.oracle_recheck_days, and priority.oracle_disagreement_share x the tier weight added after the coverage-gap boost, limited to what is left under the same cap; the oracle_recheck weight is charged to that cap too (cut to what is left), so the boosts and that reason together stay one point under the gap to the next tier up (R-ORD-02, R-ORD-14). It stops after the same disagreement survives 5 check cycles (and at most 6 cycles per 30 days however often it clears), and clears when the oracles agree. head_poll_hours: how often the head poll (pump/heads.mjs, LANE_HEADS_ENABLED) starts a new cycle over a tier's subjects (0 = every pump run); a new default-branch head moves the subject's sha (new_version) and a release published since its last change moves changed_at (change_event).
